label: DOJ sues Google over search
summary: The Department of Justice and a group of states file the search monopolisation case in the District of Columbia.

label: Search liability ruling
summary: A federal court finds Google an unlawful monopolist in general search services and search text advertising.

label: Ad tech liability ruling
summary: A federal court finds Google unlawfully monopolised the publisher ad server and ad exchange markets and illegally tied DFP to AdX.

label: Search remedies decision
summary: Behavioural remedies ordered. Chrome divestiture rejected. Data sharing with approved competitors and a syndication pathway required.

label: Search final judgment
summary: A six-year framework is finalised, including a five-year syndication pathway for search results and search text ads.

label: Google files appeal
summary: Google appeals the search-case data-sharing requirements and oversight. The DOJ and states cross-appeal on 3 February 2026.

label: Stay denied, remedies stand
summary: The district court denies Google's motion to stay the data-sharing mandate, so the search remedies remain in force during the appeal. Google files its opening appeal brief on 22 May 2026.

label: Ad tech remedies (pending)
summary: The ad tech remedies ruling is expected in 2026. The DOJ seeks divestiture of AdX and open-sourcing of the auction logic.
